name: Carbauxine Gas Deposit
disable: DC 28 Survival check (trained) to disperse the gas safely
reset: The gas builds up over the course of 24 hours, after which it can trigger again.

items.name: Combustion
items.text:
Trigger A source of open flame, such as a lit torch or a spell that deals fire damage, is brought into the area

---
Effect The gas explodes. Any creature in the area takes 4d10+22 fire damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save).

text: A colorless, odorless, and highly flammable gas fills the area.
